verdict.rationale: Accessibility tooling is a fair axis for a desktop OS, but the evidence pack never mentions a screen reader, magnifier, or other accessibility tools in Fedora Workstation. Dark mode and night light (fedora-docs-7) are comfort and display features, not accessibility tools for getting started, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use built-in screen readers and accessibility tools to get started with the OS
